card.name: Just before sulfur-word endings
card.fires_on: The last piece before a sulfur-containing word is completed, such as 'sulfate', 'sulfite' or 'sulfonamide'. It fires inside words like metabisulfite, thiosulfate and methylsulfate, or after chondroitin and dehydroepiandrosterone.

modes.description: A number or word just before 'sulphur' in an old chemistry passage.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write sul- / sulf- / sulfur pieces, such as sulfate or sulfite, next.
card.plain: It fires when a sulfur word like sulfite or sulfate is about to be written.
